title: Forward degreewise currying construction
statement: For every site C with topology J, sheaf R of commutative rings in universe max u v, cochain complexes K,L,M of R-modules, and integer n, there exists a morphism a from homComplex K (homComplex L M) in degree n to homComplex (Tot(K tensor L)) M in degree n satisfying the localized pure-tensor evaluation equation: for a section s over U, an object W of the localized site C/U, and local sections x of K^p and y of L^q, the (p+q)-projection of a(s), evaluated on the image of x tensor y under the sheafification unit and the total-tensor summand inclusion, equals the q-projection of the p-projection of s evaluated first on x and then on y. No uniqueness or invertibility is asserted.

proof.text: For each total degree t and summand p+q=t, compose the outer Hom projection with the single-sheaf pair construction, using the inner Hom projection as its second evaluation. This gives a map from the iterated Hom term to internalHom(K^p tensor L^q,M^(t+n)) with the required local pure-tensor formula.

Use mapBifunctorDesc and its summand equations to prove that the total-tensor inclusions are a colimit cofan. internalHomCoproductFanIsLimit turns this into a product fan. Lift the preceding family through that fan to a map into internalHom(T^t,M^(t+n)), retaining all summand restriction equations.

Use the Hom-complex product fan supplied by homComplex_projections_exists (the specification of homComplex_exists) to lift the maps for all t into the target Hom term. Evaluate its projection equation followed by the summand restriction equation on a local pure tensor. The definition of homObjMap turns this into evaluation after the total summand inclusion; the single-sheaf equation is exactly HomTensorDegreewiseEquation.

theorem homTensorDegreewise_construct (K L M : CochainComplex Mod ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
    ∃ a : (homComplex (R := R) K (homComplex (R := R) L M)).X n ⟶
      (homComplex (R := R)
        (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)) M).X n,
      HomTensorDegreewiseEquation R K L M n a
